# aiXplain Docs

> LLM-readable entrypoint for the aiXplain Python SDK v2 reference.

Use `llms-full.txt` when you want the complete SDK v2 reference in one context window.

## Recommended

- [SDK v2 full reference](llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated aiXplain Python SDK v2 API reference.
- [SDK v2 landing page](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/init.md): Package overview for `aixplain.v2`.

## SDK v2 Modules

- [aixplain.v2](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/init.md): aiXplain SDK v2 - Modern Python SDK for the aiXplain platform.
- [aixplain.v2.actions](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/actions.md): `from aixplain import Action, Actions, Input, Inputs`
- [aixplain.v2.agent](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/agent.md): `from aixplain import Agent, AgentResponseData, AgentRunResult, Artifact, Budget, BudgetDict, ContextOverflowStrategy, ContextOverflowStrategyValue, ConversationMessage, OutputFormat, OutputFormatValue, RoleModelRef, Task, TaskDict`
- [aixplain.v2.agent_evaluator](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/agent_evaluator.md): `from aixplain import AgentEvaluationResultsChatbot, AgentEvaluationRow, AgentEvaluationRun, Dataset, Eval, EvalCase, Metric, MetricResponse, compare_agents_side_by_side, normalize_eval_results_dataframe`
- [aixplain.v2.agent_progress](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/agent_progress.md): `from aixplain import AgentProgressTracker, ProgressFormat, ProgressFormatValue`
- [aixplain.v2.api_key](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/api_key.md): `from aixplain import APIKey, APIKeyLimits, APIKeyLimitsDict, APIKeyLimitsInput, APIKeyUsageLimit, TokenType, TokenTypeValue`
- [aixplain.v2.client](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/client.md): Client module for making HTTP requests to the aiXplain API.
- [aixplain.v2.code_utils](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/code_utils.md): `from aixplain import UtilityModelInput, UtilityModelInputDict`
- [aixplain.v2.core](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/core.md): `from aixplain import Aixplain`
- [aixplain.v2.enums](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/enums.md): `from aixplain import AssetStatus, AssetStatusValue, AttachmentType, AttachmentTypeValue, AuthenticationScheme, AuthenticationSchemeValue, CodeInterpreterModel, DataType, DataTypeValue, ErrorHandler, EvolveType, FileContentType, FileType, FileTypeValue, Function, FunctionType, FunctionValue, Language, LanguageValue, License, LicenseValue, MessageRole, OnboardStatus, OwnershipType, OwnershipTypeValue, Privacy, PrivacyValue, Reaction, ResponseStatus, RunStatus, SessionStatus, SortBy, SortByValue, SortOrder, SortOrderValue, SplittingOptions, SplittingOptionsValue, StorageType, StorageTypeValue, Supplier, SupplierValue`
- [aixplain.v2.eval_experiment](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/eval_experiment.md): `from aixplain import EXPERIMENT_COMPARISON_COL_RUN_CREATED_AT, EXPERIMENT_COMPARISON_COL_RUN_INDEX, Experiment, ExperimentLocalCache, ExperimentRun, ExperimentRunDiff, ExperimentRunDiffCase, ExperimentRunDiffCaseList, default_experiment_cache_dir`
- [aixplain.v2.eval_results_display](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/eval_results_display.md): `from aixplain import case_comparison_html, case_rows, guess_compare_value_columns, load_eval_csv, pivot_agents_wide, summarize_by_agent`
- [aixplain.v2.exceptions](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/exceptions.md): `from aixplain import APIError, AixplainIssueError, AixplainV2Error, FileUploadError, ResourceError, TimeoutError, UntrustedURLError, ValidationError`
- [aixplain.v2.file](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/file.md): `from aixplain import File`
- [aixplain.v2.graph](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/graph.md): `from aixplain import AgentNode, Condition, ConditionDict, ConditionalNode, Edge, EdgeDict, Graph, GraphDict, InspectorNode, LLMNode, Node, RawNode, RetryPolicy, RetryPolicyDict, ScriptNode, StaticGraphStrategy, StaticGraphStrategyDict, ToolNode`
- [aixplain.v2.inspector](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/inspector.md): `from aixplain import AUTO_DEFAULT_MODEL_ID, Inspector`
- [aixplain.v2.integration](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/integration.md): `from aixplain import ActionInputSpec, ActionSpec, Integration, IntegrationResult, ToolId, TriggerEventOption, TriggerTypeSpec, TriggerTypes`
- [aixplain.v2.issue](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/issue.md): `from aixplain import IssueReporter, IssueSeverity, IssueSeverityValue`
- [aixplain.v2.meta_agents](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/meta_agents.md): `from aixplain import DebugResult, Debugger`
- [aixplain.v2.mixins](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/mixins.md): `from aixplain import ParameterDefinition, ParameterInput, ToolDict`
- [aixplain.v2.model](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/model.md): `from aixplain import CompletionTokensDetails, Detail, Message, Model, ModelResponseStreamer, ModelResult, Parameter, Pricing, PromptTokensDetails, StreamChunk, Usage, VendorInfo, Version`
- [aixplain.v2.plain_data](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/plain_data.md): Coercion of plain dicts into the v2 config structs (PROD-2921).
- [aixplain.v2.resource](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/resource.md): `from aixplain import DeleteResult, Page, Result`
- [aixplain.v2.rlm](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/rlm.md): `from aixplain import RLM, RLMResult`
- [aixplain.v2.session](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/session.md): `from aixplain import ExecutionConfig, ExecutionConfigDict, Session, SessionMessage, SessionMessageAttachment`
- [aixplain.v2.skill](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/skill.md): `from aixplain import Skill`
- [aixplain.v2.tool](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/tool.md): `from aixplain import Tool, ToolResult`
- [aixplain.v2.trigger](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/trigger.md): `from aixplain import Trigger, TriggerConfiguration, TriggerConfigurationDict, TriggerRepeatRule, TriggerRepeatRuleDict`
- [aixplain.v2.upload_utils](api-reference/python/aixplain/v2/upload_utils.md): `from aixplain import FileUploader, upload_file, validate_file_for_upload`
